name: All Credits
query:
SELECT
  sc.name AS `Reference`,
  sc.supplier AS `Supplier`,
  sc.dated AS `Date`,
  sc.source_document_type AS `Source Type`,
  sc.source_document AS `Source Document`,
  sc.total_amount AS `Total Amount`,
  sc.amount_paid AS `Amount Paid`,
  sc.balance AS `Balance`,
  sc.status AS `Status`
FROM `tabSupplier Credit` sc
WHERE sc.docstatus < 2
  AND (%(supplier)s IS NULL OR %(supplier)s = '' OR sc.supplier = %(supplier)s)
  AND (%(from_date)s IS NULL OR %(from_date)s = '' OR sc.dated >= %(from_date)s)
  AND (%(to_date)s IS NULL OR %(to_date)s = '' OR sc.dated <= %(to_date)s)
ORDER BY sc.dated DESC
